newsitem.title: USA: Molex order backlog up 9 pct at Q3.
newsitem.headline: Molex order backlog up 9 pct at Q3.

text.p: Molex Inc said Monday its order backlog at March 31, the end of its third fiscal quarter, rose nine percent to $246.8 million from $226.4 million in the same year-ago period.

It said third-quarter research and development expenditures were $23.9 million, up 11.7 percent over last year. Capital expenditures were $52.2 million compared with $51.1 million over the same period last year.
Chairman Fred Krehbiel said, "We plan to invest $215 million in capital expenditures and $90 million in R&D for the full fiscal year ending June 30, 1997."

Molex, a manufacturer of electronic, electrical and fiber optic connector products, reported third-quarter earnings of $43.2 million or $0.34 per share, up from $36.1 million or $0.29 per share. Revenue in the quarter rose to $387.1 million from $347.1 million.
"Net return on sales for the third quarter was 11.2 percent, marking the twelfth consecutive quarter in which we have exceeded our corporate goal of 10 percent," Krehbiel added in a statement.
